chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: Hawaii and snow in California on the way home
summary: He left Haley's group in Hawaii, flew home with The Drifters and The Platters in an unexpected snowfall.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: After we come back from Australia, I got off in Hawaii. Bill Haley 'n' them went to San Francisco but I didn't wanta go with... They were tryin' to get me to go with 'em. I said, "Naw, I'm goin' home and see my mother."

So we left Hawaii, an' I got on a plane with The Drifters, The Platters 'n' them. So we all come back to California. When we got back to California, it was snowin'. First snow I ever saw in California. It was cold as somethin'. I had a big overcoat, was big enough for me an' two other people. So they rest o' them didn't bring they coats... put 'em in they suitcases. So I was holdin' one o' the girls in front o' my coat to keep her warm while we's leavin' the airport t'll we got in a cab. After that, we scattered, an' ever'body went home, and I came to see my mother, which I had bought her a home, the place I'm livin' in right now.
